thread:
alex: Morning handoff — taking over from @maria :sunrise:

maria: Left prod green. Quick summary of what changed since last night:
- Canary rollout of 3.2.1 started at 02:10 UTC (canary -> 20% currently).
- Reduced embeddings cache TTL from 2h -> 30m to cut stale hits.
- Applied a staging NFS mount patch (no prod impact).

alex: Thanks — any errors or customer-facing issues?

maria: Saw a handful of transient 503s from model-proxy around 02:28 that auto-retried. Tail of logs below:
```
model-proxy ERROR connect timeout to gpu-node-7 02:28:14
model-proxy INFO retrying request id=abc123
```
Opened internal ticket: https://redwood/internal/issue/1234 (note: low priority, auto-retries handled it).

samir: Heads-up — the dedicated cluster autoscaler took longer than usual during the canary ramp; node drain latency spiked to ~90s which can lead to slightly slower cold-start for large seq requests. Watch cold-start latency over next 2h.

alex: Action items for tonight (short):
1) Monitor model-proxy 5xx rate — if >0.5% sustained for 15m, rollback canary.
2) Watch embeddings cache hit rate (target >85%) after TTL change.
3) If cold-start p95 > 2s, enable burst capacity: `rctl set burst=on` and ping jess.

jess: I'm covering infra overlap from 22:00 UTC — available to toggle burst or drain nodes manually.

ops-bot: Scheduled job `snapshot-backups` completed successfully at 1779004000.

alex: I'll run a quick smoke test at 10:30 UTC and post results here. Quick smoke checklist:
- /v1/health -> 200
- small-text gen p95 < 300ms
- embedding lookup hit rate > 85%

maria: One more note: a small group of EU private deploy customers reported tokenization latency +~10% (telemetry ticket 789). No error spikes, just latency bump. Might be unrelated infra noise but flagging.

alex: Ack — will add an alert for tokenization p99 +10% and watch dashboards.

samir: Also: PR #4527 (kv-cache eviction) is queued and needs a final review. Low-risk but could cause temporary cache hit drop if merged during heavy traffic. Recommend merging in low-traffic window.

alex: I'll review PR #4527 in the next hour and coordinate timing.

jess: Note on config: canary has `max_inflight_per_gpu` bumped 64 -> 80. If you see memory OOMs revert to 64 and alert me.

alex: Will do. Signing out at 11:05 UTC if nothing pops. Leaving handoff in the thread — ping me here or DM if you see anything odd. :thumbsup:
